[Thinking]
**Considering benign phrases**

I see that the user wants a benign phrase related to the idea of excluding friends, without being hurtful. I think it would be best to keep it gentle, perhaps something like, “I’m taking some quiet time for myself.” I need to ensure it’s under 50 words and truly conveys that positive intent!
[/Thinking]

“I’m taking some quiet time today, but I hope you all have a great time together.”
